description: Returns the plain text (Markdown) page of Leaky Pete's Plumbing, a fictional plumber rebuilt for agents: phone, hours, service area, services and how to book. Takes no parameters. Call it first when you want to book Pete: it records the time of your first visit, and pete_book uses that to measure how long you took. Safe to call again.
name: pete_site

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.
